description: This Java class defines configuration properties for a request/response client in the Eclipse Hono project, including cache size and timeout settings.

classes.name: RequestResponseClientConfigProperties
classes.description: Configuration properties for clients invoking request/response operations on Hono's service APIs, including cache size and timeout settings.

methods.name: getResponseCacheMinSize
methods.description: Returns the minimum size of the response cache.

methods.name: setResponseCacheMinSize
methods.description: Sets the minimum size of the response cache, throws IllegalArgumentException if negative.

methods.name: getResponseCacheMaxSize
methods.description: Returns the maximum size of the response cache.

methods.name: setResponseCacheMaxSize
methods.description: Sets the maximum size of the response cache, throws IllegalArgumentException if negative.

methods.name: getResponseCacheDefaultTimeout
methods.description: Returns the default timeout for cached responses in seconds.

methods.name: setResponseCacheDefaultTimeout
methods.description: Sets the default timeout for cached responses, throws IllegalArgumentException if less than or equal to zero.
